interval.description: Upper bound in seconds between reconciliation passes. A host link event reconciles sooner. A non-positive or non-integer value would reach read and CrashLoop every node.

settleMs.description: Milliseconds of quiet to wait after host link events before reconciling, so a pass does not run while Dranet is still configuring a PF. 0 reconciles immediately.

shapes.description: Shapes the reconciler is allowed to schedule on, matched on node.kubernetes.io/instance-type. Empty schedules everywhere.
